notes: E-Series capacity IS available from Active IQ (SantricitySystem.capacity on the systems query) -- the UI's 'not exposed via the Active IQ GraphQL API' message was only true of the clusters query. 26 of 33 real E-Series systems return total/allocated/free/unconfigured capacity. Harvested via a small dedicated query merged by serial (the main query is at Active IQ's field-count limit), mapped into the standard capacity fields, and shown in a new E-Series panel; systems with no report keep an accurate note.
